author: bardic-inspiration
name: Carrion Stag
summary: A risen forest stag with rotting antlers and a lowered head.
description: A carrion stag still rides the old rut, charging at anything that enters its glade. Foresters know the antlers are good for knife handles and bad luck to keep.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the stag moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an Antler Gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {dmg:1d8:piercing} and, if it is Large or smaller, has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The stag makes one Antler Gore attack and one Hoof Stomp attack.

actions.name: Hoof Stomp
actions.attackNote: with Advantage if the target has the Prone condition
